info.title: Access Analyzer

requests.description: Retroactively applies the archive rule to existing findings that meet the archive rule criteria.
requests.name: PUT /archive-rule
requests.note: Replace {{ACCESS_ANALYZER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Cancels the requested policy generation.

requests.description: Retrieves the policy that was generated using StartPolicyGeneration.

requests.description: Creates an access preview that allows you to preview IAM Access Analyzer findings for your resource before deploying resource permissions.

requests.description: Creates an analyzer for your account.
requests.name: PUT /analyzer
requests.note: Replace {{ACCESS_ANALYZER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Creates an archive rule for the specified analyzer. Archive rules automatically archive new findings that meet the criteria you define when you create the rule.

To learn about filter keys that you can use to create an archive rule, see IAM Access Analyzer filter keys in the IAM User Guide.
requests.name: PUT /analyzer/{analyzerName}/archive-rule
requests.note: Replace {{ACCESS_ANALYZER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.name: GET /analyzer/{analyzerName}/archive-rule
requests.note: Replace {{ACCESS_ANALYZER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes the specified analyzer. When you delete an analyzer, IAM Access Analyzer is disabled for the account or organization in the current or specific Region. All findings that were generated by the analyzer are deleted. You cannot undo this action.
requests.name: DELETE /analyzer/{analyzerName}
requests.note: Replace {{ACCESS_ANALYZER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves information about the specified analyzer.
